matches.preview: The model narrowly favours Charlton Athletic at 38%, but with Queens Park Rangers at 33% and the draw at 28%, this match is finely balanced. Charlton ended last season with one win in six matches, while QPR lost their final four fixtures, including a 3-0 defeat away to Ipswich. The latest meeting finished 0-0, although QPR won the previous encounter 3-1. Those contrasting head-to-head results add to the uncertainty around the outcome. For total goals, the model leans towards under 2.5 at 57%, compared with 43% for over 2.5.
matches.preview_zh: 模型以38%的機率略微看好Charlton Athletic，但Queens Park Rangers的機率為33%，平局則為28%，顯示本場比賽局勢相當接近。Charlton Athletic上賽季最後六場比賽僅取得一勝，QPR則在最後四場賽事全數落敗，其中包括客場以0比3不敵Ipswich。兩隊最近一次交手以0比0收場，但前一次對決由QPR以3比1獲勝。這些截然不同的交手結果，進一步增加了比賽結果的不確定性。總進球數方面，模型認為低於2.5球的機率為57%，高於2.5球則為43%。
